description: r.side holds t.p, which panics after a 10 ns sleep, and t.c, which is cancelled when the driver closes the region at 50 (the cancel makes the scheduler non-empty, so the close's first idle round takes a step that fires t.p's due timer and t.p panics there). The region's close outcome joins their outcomes by severity (Ok < Err < Cancelled < Panicked): the panic wins over the cancel, so the driver's observation at 60 is Panicked with t.p's message, although the region itself was closed by a cancel.
